name: financial_calculator
description: Performs one of six discrete financial calculations selected by the calculator_type parameter. compound_interest: total value and interest earned given principal, annual rate, and years. loan_repayment: monthly payment, total repayable, and total interest for a mortgage or loan given principal, annual rate percent, and term in months. roi: return on investment percentage and profit or loss given initial and final values, with optional annualised ROI. present_value: discounts a future amount to today's value using a discount rate and time horizon in years. future_value: projects a present amount forward at a compounding annual rate over years. break_even: units sold and revenue required to cover fixed costs given variable cost per unit and price per unit. Use this tool when an agent needs to model investment growth, calculate mortgage repayments, evaluate returns on capital, discount future cash flows, or determine business viability. All computations are performed locally with no external API dependency.

calculator_type.description: The type of financial calculation to perform. One of: compound_interest, loan_repayment, roi, present_value, future_value, break_even.

principal.description: Starting amount or loan amount in your chosen currency. Used for compound_interest, loan_repayment, and future_value calculations.

rate.description: Annual interest or discount rate expressed as a percentage. Example: 5 for 5% per year. Used for compound_interest, loan_repayment, present_value, and future_value.

periods.description: Number of time periods. For compound_interest and future_value: years. For loan_repayment: months. For roi: years used for annualised ROI.

initial_value.description: Starting value of an investment or asset. Used for roi calculations.

final_value.description: Ending value of an investment or asset. Used for roi and present_value calculations.

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate as a percentage for present value calculations. Represents the required rate of return or cost of capital.

future_amount.description: The target future cash amount to discount back to present value. Used for present_value calculations.

fixed_costs.description: Total fixed costs of the business or project that do not vary with output volume. Used for break_even calculations.

variable_cost_per_unit.description: The variable cost incurred for each unit produced or sold. Used for break_even calculations.

price_per_unit.description: The selling price per unit of product or service. Used for break_even calculations.
